title: Foundations of Aqeedah — Planting Iman in the Young
description: A 10-lesson pathway that teaches the father/mother the foundations of the correct Islamic aqeedah so they can teach their children (ages 3-12). Built upon the Qur’an and Sunnah according to the understanding of the Salaf of the Ummah, far from disputes.

primary_reference.info: al-Aqidah al-Tahawiyyah; al-Qawa'id al-Arba' and Thalathat al-Usul by Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab, with Ibn Uthaymin's commentary; As'ilat al-Atfal al-Imaniyyah; al-Aqidah Awwalan (al-Juraysh)
